messages:
tess: Julian from the auditor team asked for a post-incident evidence package for INC-2026-0421 — specifically a KMS access graph, key policy history, and a signed snapshot of S3 logs. Can someone own collection + provenance proof?
compliance-bot: Please include key ARNs, affected IAM/service accounts, time window, presigned URL audit (who created it), and a SHA256 + signed manifest. See internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/export-playbook
sam: I can collect CloudTrail + S3 logs. Quick Q: do you need KMS key policy change history or principal-delegation timeline as well?
julian (auditor): Yes to both. We need to know who had Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/Encrypt+AssumeRole events in the window. Also want the access graph in a machine-readable format (CSV or GraphML) and a signed manifest listing checksums and actors.
tess: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail events for KMS + STS AssumeRole 2) snapshot current key policy and rotation metadata 3) export k8s RoleBindings + AWS IAM role bindings 4) package S3 logs + manifest + sha256 + GPG sig. Sam, can you run the commands below and upload to evidence bucket with a presign?
sam: Running now. Commands I'll use:
```
# cloudtrail KMS window
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time "2026-03-20T00:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-20T06:00:00Z" > cloudtrail_kms.json

# key policy snapshot
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd1234 --policy-name default > key_policy.json

# k8s rolebindings
kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -A -o yaml > k8s_rolebindings.yaml
```
oncall: Heads-up: for chain-of-custody include who executed aws sts:GetCallerIdentity before upload, and retain CloudTrail entry for the presign creation. Also, if possible enable S3 Object Lock or set retention to prevent tampering until audit sign-off.
julian (auditor): For the signed snapshot we expect: a SHA256 checksum of the tar.gz, a detached GPG signature created with your compliance signing key (public key uploaded to the auditor portal), and a manifest.json mapping filenames -> checksums -> exporter identity.
tess: We'll sign with compliance@redwood-internal key. Sam, please capture STS identity and add it to the manifest. Also include the time window for exported events and the exact key ARNs.
sam: Creating tarball now:
```
tar czf inc2026_kms_snapshot.tar.gz cloudtrail_kms.json key_policy.json k8s_rolebindings.yaml s3_logs/
sha256sum inc2026_kms_snapshot.tar.gz > inc2026.sha256
gpg --output inc2026.sig --detach-sign --local-user compliance@redwood-internal inc2026_kms_snapshot.tar.gz
```
sam: Uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026/ and created presigned URL (7d). Presigned URL creation is logged in CloudTrail under S3:PutObject and should include sts:GetCallerIdentity call. (I will not paste full URL here).
tess: Also need an access graph export. Use the IAM graph tool: `python tools/iam_graph.py --keys arns.txt --output inc2026_kms_graph.graphml` — include graphml in the tarball.
sam: Graph generated and included.
julian (auditor): We saw a k8s rolebinding change at 2026-03-20T01:12:00Z in preliminary logs. Please include kube-audit logs and a short diff of the RoleBinding object showing before/after subjects.
tess: Adding kube-audit.json and a small excerpt showing the change:
```
# excerpt
- subjects: [{kind: User, name: svc-buildbot}]
+ subjects: [{kind: User, name: svc-buildprod}]
```
compliance-bot: Reminder: add mapping to control IDs (SOC2 CC6.2 / ISO 27001 A.9.2.1) in the manifest metadata.
oncall: Add vulnerability triage notes and link to incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0421 — include who triaged, severity, fix state.
julian (auditor): One more: export KMS metadata showing KeyState, RotationStatus, LastRotationDate, and any external wrapping keys (e.g., CloudHSM). We need to validate key history during the incident window.
tess: Will include kms_metadata.json from `aws kms describe-key` and `list-grant` outputs. Also add rotation_status and any CloudHSM logs if present.
sam: All artifacts uploaded. Manifest summary (high level):
- files: cloudtrail_kms.json, key_policy.json, kms_metadata.json, k8s_rolebindings.yaml, kube-audit.json, inc2026_kms_graph.graphml, s3_logs/*, inc2026_kms_snapshot.tar.gz, inc2026.sha256, inc2026.sig
- exported_by: sam@redwood.com
- exported_at: 2026-03-20T08:45:12Z
- presign_creator: sam@redwood.com
- presign_created_at: 2026-03-20T08:47:00Z
- control_map: ["SOC2 CC6.2","ISO27001 A.9.2.1"]

sam: sha256 (truncated): d2c7f9e2... ; signature attached. julian, can you confirm you can access and validate?
julian (auditor): Received the tarball and signature. I'll validate checksum + GPG sig and confirm. If I need a deeper artifact (e.g., original CloudTrail S3 objects or KMS decrypt logs), I'll ping back. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
tess: Thanks team — I'll update the evidence tracker with the presigned link, manifest, and control mapping. If the auditor asks for timeline narration we'll draft a short narrative of actions during 2026-03-20T00:00-06:00Z.
compliance-bot: Evidence package created: INC-2026/evidence-v1 — follow the evidence playbook for handoff steps.
